answer: A single fake is a craft project; a hundred is an industry. Vetted wind turbine technician licence with renewable energy attestation makes the industry visible: a licence energy officers renew after turbine audits. The thread is the factory floor — the supervisors, the stamps, the histories, each needing its own room. Each unit needs its own supervisor and its own paper trail, and the lotus is the floor manager: one person coordinating lies full-time, leaving a trail in every ledger they touch. The plume is the pattern across all hundred, which the checker sees at once.
